## Code signing policy

See the project [Code signing policy](https://github.com/gooderno1/codex-companion/blob/main/CODE_SIGNING_POLICY.md).

> Free code signing provided by [SignPath.io](https://signpath.io/), certificate by [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org/).

在 SignPath Foundation 明确批准并完成签名工作流验收前，Release 必须说明 Windows 产物仍未签名；批准后则必须列出 Authenticode 验证结果和 SHA256。
